# Overview

```{r model_family_header, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
acousticTS:::.model_family_header(
  family = "sphms",
  pages = c(
    Overview = "index.html",
    Implementation = "sphms-implementation.html",
    Theory = "sphms-theory.html"
  )
)
```

```{r sphms_overview, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
acousticTS:::.model_family_overview(
  family = "sphms",
  summary = paste(
    "The spherical modal-series solution (`SPHMS`) calculates scattering",
    "from an unshelled, homogeneous sphere in an exterior fluid. It is the",
    "package's primary spherical reference model."
  ),
  core_idea = paste(
    "Expand the incident, scattered, and interior fields in spherical partial",
    "waves, apply the selected interface condition independently at each",
    "angular order, and sum the far-field coefficients. This separation is",
    "exact for a spherical interface [@Anderson_1950; @Hickling_1962]."
  ),
  best_for = c(
    "Fixed-rigid, pressure-release, liquid-filled, or gas-filled spheres",
    "Canonical checks of boundary and material-property effects",
    "Spherical reference cases for approximate or more general solvers"
  ),
  supports = c(
    "`Sphere` geometry carried by `FLS` or `GAS` scatterers",
    "Homogeneous interiors with seawater as exterior medium `1`",
    "Monostatic complex amplitude, backscattering cross-section, and target strength"
  ),
  assumptions = c(
    "A perfectly spherical, unshelled interface",
    "Homogeneous properties within each region",
    "Linear time-harmonic acoustics",
    "No elastic shear waves, viscous layer, or nonspherical orientation effects"
  ),
  reading = c(
    "[Implementation](sphms-implementation.html): object construction, boundaries, output, and comparisons",
    "[Theory](sphms-theory.html): field expansions, boundary systems, and modal coefficients"
  )
)
```
